milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the 'play noteblock' task requires the player to navigate to the noteblock at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4) and face it to interact. Among the 5 available rule types (inventory_has, position_inside_box, position_near_with_facing, count_in_box_at_least, count_in_box_at_most), none directly track use_item or block interaction events. position_near_with_facing is the best available proxy: it verifies the player is within 1.5 blocks (tight enough to require being at interaction range) and facing the noteblock (within 45° tolerance). This is a known limitation — the rule confirms the player is positioned to interact but cannot confirm the click itself. max_distance=1.5 is chosen because Minecraft interaction range is ~4.5 blocks, but requiring the player to be within 1.5 blocks strongly implies intentional approach to the noteblock rather than incidental proximity. facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking directly at the noteblock.
